verdict.rationale: Free public document generators or downloadable startup forms are a fair question for a startup-focused law firm, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes attorney-prepared documents for clients: entity formation, financing documents, and seed and convertible financings. Nothing shows free public generators or downloadable incorporation, SAFE, term sheet, or NDA templates available to non-clients.

support.subject: As a founder, I can use the firm's free public document generators or downloadable startup forms — incorporation documents, SAFEs/term sheets, NDAs — without being a client
